source_summary: A tall-format Chinese painting centered on scholars and attendants beneath dense pines and leafy trees; calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from the motif bank.

motifs.name: overhanging_pine_bough
motifs.description: Isolate the sweeping upper-right pine bough that arcs diagonally across the painting, including the twisting ocher-brown branch, exposed angular offshoots, and all dark needle clusters along the branch tips.
must_preserve: fine black pine-needle sprays radiating from each tuft
twisted branch contour lines and warm brown wash
small ink dots along knots and bark scars
angular bare twig extensions at the far right
irregular spacing of needle clusters

motifs.name: tall_right_pine_trunk_and_canopy
motifs.description: Isolate the tall right-side pine section below the overhanging bough: the vertical trunk, dense dark rounded foliage masses, exposed roots, and the immediate mossy base around it.
must_preserve: vertical bark striations and pale brown trunk wash
dense stippled dark-green foliage texture
black dot accents on bark and branch joints
root flare at the base
moss dots and small ground strokes around the trunk

motifs.name: central_leafy_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the central grove of smaller trees with multiple pale trunks and rounded canopies made of many radial leaf rosettes, including the intertwined branches and visible roots.
must_preserve: repeated starburst leaf clusters drawn with fine ink strokes
pale ocher trunks with sinuous outlines
interlacing branch structure visible through foliage
dark stippled shadow masses behind trunks
root and base lines at the foreground ground plane

motifs.name: central_dark_understory
motifs.description: Isolate the dark understory thicket behind and between the central trees: compact black-green foliage masses, slender trunks, and mossy ground patches, excluding nearby figures.
must_preserve: dense stippled foliage dots
soft green-gray wash under dark ink marks
thin vertical sapling trunks
irregular silhouette of the shrub masses
small moss flecks along the lower edge

motifs.name: right_mossy_rock_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the low rock and shrub cluster to the right of the tall pine trunk, including the ocher rocks, blue-green wash accents, contour lines, and dotted moss.
must_preserve: angular rock outlines in thin ink
blue-green mineral wash patches
black moss dots scattered on and around the rocks
small scrubby grass strokes
uneven ground contour beneath the rocks

motifs.name: left_seated_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the seated scholar at the lower left, including his red outer robe, pale undergarment, black cap, face, hands, and the low seat or rock directly supporting him.
must_preserve: delicate facial linework and black cap
muted red robe wash
thin robe-fold outlines
seated posture with hands near the lap
small ground and support strokes immediately under the figure

motifs.name: standing_scholar_attendant
motifs.description: Isolate the standing robed figure near the lower-left grove, including the head, long pale robe, dark belt or sash details, hands, and small object held near the body.
must_preserve: fine ink outline of the face and hair or cap
long vertical robe folds
subtle pale wash on the garment
dark sash and hand details
slight forward-leaning stance

motifs.name: central_attendant_with_red_tray
motifs.description: Isolate the partially framed central attendant beneath the trees, including the pale robe, visible head and hands, red rectangular tray or offering object, and lower garment lines.
must_preserve: small red tray accent
thin robe outlines partially obscured by tree forms
delicate head and facial strokes
vertical garment folds
muted wash transitions around the figure

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
